column1: # gpu/amd/card.tsv: bytes of the AMD back end recorded by receipts, written once from them and never regenerated
# from a build. Checked by gpu/amd/gate.om (OMEGA-GPU-AMD). KIND NAME SHA256, one space apart.
# obj: the object gpu/amd/gfx942/NAME.isa gives through the code-object writer; it ran on the MI300X.
# bin: the binary of a gate unit; it ran on the MI300X.
# host: the binary of a gate unit, built and recorded on the host, never run on the card (a reference only).
#   obj and bin: evidence/amd-qwen38-native-refusal-20261113/native/MANIFEST.json, the MI300X run of
#   Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 through the direct-KFD launcher: code/NAME.hsaco, vadd.hsaco, omega-launch (= launch-x86)
